newsitem.title: POLAND: Espebepe creditors to meet March 14.
newsitem.headline: Espebepe creditors to meet March 14.

text.p: Creditors of ailing Polish construction firm Espebepe SA, which has more than 35 million zlotys in debts, will meet on March 14, the company said in a statement on Friday, giving no other details.
Last October Espebepe president Andrzej Hass told Reuters he expected the company's creditors to make a final decision on a proposed debt-cutting deal in the first quarter of 1997.
He said he would seek to write off as much as 90 percent of Espebepe's debt and that the company could go bankrupt if it failed to do so.
Espebepe made a net loss of 20.6 million zlotys over 1996's first 11 months after losing 17.9 million in 1995.
Hass, who took over as president in the middle of last year, said the new management had launched an overhaul of the company but the burden of old debts and bad contracts could derail its efforts.
Among the company's 28 largest creditors, to which it owes 35 million zlotys, are banks PBR and WBK.
